notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 unnamed federation join overload. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies generated federate-name identity, named-member reporting, reversible federate lookups, resignation, federation destruction, and standard cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador unnamed and named joinFederationExecution overloads with federate lookup, member reporting, resignation, and federation destruction services
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador federation membership and lookup declarations
